title: Out of the Dark
medium: 24 layer silkscreen lithograph on 410gsm Somerset Tub Sized Satin paper with a matte varnish seal and deckled edges.

said.q: a colour that reveals darkness in a deep and mysterious way.

Out of the Dark immerses the viewer in a mountain-like form that opens into a deep blue cavernous void. That first print by Kapoor evoke ‘sites of origin’ as mounds, mountains and voids in deeply saturated colours.

events.n: printed by Make-Ready; the artist's first silkscreen print
events.q: Working closely with Kapoor, printmakers at Make-Ready in London paid close attention to chromatic accuracy.
